title: Hog Saga: Launch Quest
tagline: Made for Acme Rockets by PostHog

text.win: The Scrub Monster is grounded for good. Acme's next launch lifts off on time, bug-free.
text.lose: Mission scrubbed. Refuel at the inn, check your telemetry and try the launch again.
text.credits: Made for the Acme Rockets crew by PostHog

game.intro: T-minus one week. Bugs have swarmed the launch range and every countdown keeps getting scrubbed.

town.name: Mission Control
town.inn_line: Long countdown? Bunks are in the back, coffee is always hot.

regions.name: Test Range
regions.blurb: Green on Tuesday, red on launch day.

regions.name: Launch Pad Flats
regions.blurb: Hot sand, hot engines, hotter incidents.

party.name: Nova
party.sprite_prompt: a telemetry analyst with round glasses and a navy flight jacket

party.name: Rex
party.sprite_prompt: a flight support engineer with a headset and an orange jumpsuit

npcs.name: Flight Dir
npcs.line: Three scrubs this month. Customers keep finding the bugs before we do.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a flight director with a clipboard and a white shirt

npcs.name: Test Pilot
npcs.line: The test suite said green. The rocket said otherwise.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a test pilot in a silver flight suit with a helmet under one arm

npcs.name: Roadmap PM
npcs.line: We pick features by who shouts loudest. Numbers would be nice.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a product manager with a big rolled-up star chart

enemies.name: Flaky Test
enemies.pain: Passes locally, fails on the pad.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a tiny jittery grey fly with a checkmark-shaped wing

enemies.name: Prod Gremlin
enemies.sprite_prompt: a small red gremlin with sparking antennae and a wrench

enemies.name: Opinion Moth
enemies.pain: Roadmap by loudest voice in the room.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a big fluffy yellow moth with a megaphone mouth

enemies.name: Legacy Booster
enemies.pain: Nobody dares touch the old flight code.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a rusty armoured beetle shaped like an old rocket booster

enemies.name: Static Storm
enemies.pain: Telemetry noise hides the real problem.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a floating purple storm cloud crackling with radio static

boss.name: The Scrub Monster
boss.taunt: T-minus never! This launch is SCRUBBED!
boss.phase2: Abort! Abort! I will scrub every launch window!
boss.sprite_prompt: a giant navy robot shaped like a rocket fuel tank with red warning lights

product_lines.session_replay: Rewind the telemetry, see what broke
product_lines.error_tracking: Catch it before the customer calls
